children: Cosmos Health reported preliminary, unaudited revenue of approximately $54.3 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, a 19% increase versus the same period in 2025. Third-quarter preliminary revenue was approximately $17.4 million, the highest Q3 in the company's history. The company reaffirmed its outlook that full-year 2026 revenue will surpass $90 million, with Q4 expected to be the strongest quarter.
Nine-month revenue (preliminary, unaudited): approximately $54.3 million, up 19% from $45.6 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
Third-quarter revenue (preliminary, unaudited): approximately $17.4 million, up 2% versus Q3 2025 ($17.1M) and up 40% versus Q3 2024 ($12.4M).
Full-year 2026 revenue outlook: reaffirmed to surpass $90 million (company outlook, not results).
Comparative context: nine-month 2026 revenue nearly matches full-year 2024 ($54.4M) and represents ~83% of full-year 2025 revenue ($65.3M).
Recorded growth across all core segments: contract manufacturing, pharmaceutical distribution and proprietary brands contributed to revenue increases.
Contract manufacturing at Cana Laboratories reached a record production pipeline exceeding 32.7 million units (operational pipeline milestone).
Pharmaceutical distribution at CosmoFarm delivered record volumes across a network of more than 1,500 pharmacies, with network expansion continuing.

Proprietary brands (including Sky Premium Life, C-Scrub and C-Sept) expanded in established markets and entered new territories and channels globally, with accelerating sales momentum in the United States.
Each quarter of 2026 (Q1–Q3) set a record for that quarter, indicating sustained operational momentum into the fourth quarter.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Cosmos Health reports record ~$54.3M nine-month revenue; Q3 ~$17.4M, reaffirms >$90M 2026 outlook
